title: Soybean Purple seed stain - Sri Lanka

Header: Soybean Purple seed stain - Sri Lanka
Cercospora kikuhii Sinhala: Beeja dampallam Rogaya Tamil: Cercosphora ootha karai noi

Prevention: Use disease free seeds (use seeds without purple lesions).
Consider seed treatments when likelihood of occurrence is high (see yellow direct control).
Destroy infected crop debris of previous cultivation.
Maintain proper plant spacing (40 x 10 cm).
Monitoring: Observe the following symptoms especially at rapid pod growth stage to seed filling stage:
Light purplish colour on mature leaves.
Red colour lesions on young leaves.
During later stages, leaves become dry and show blight symptoms.
Also, young leaves may fall off while mature leaves remain on the plant.
Direct Control: Avoid overhead irrigation and water logged conditions.
Consider the following for seed treatment:
Rate of dilution – 20 g / 10 lit .of water.
Restrictions: Rhizobium inoculum is used, seed treatment should be applied one day before sowing (Inoculum is applied at the time of sowing)
Rate of dilution – 30 ml/ 10 lit. of water.
Toxic to predatory mites and earthworms
Toxic to predatory mites, parasitoids and fish and moderately toxic to flower bugs
